segments.text:
V. 21.
Believe me—Our LORD uſes this Expreſſion in this Manner but once; and that to a Samaritan. To his own People the Jews, his uſual Language is, I ſay unto you. The hour cometh when ye—Both Samaritans and Jews, ſhall worſhip neither in this mountain, nor at Jeruſalem—As preferable to any other Place. True Worſhip ſhall be no longer confined to any one Place or Nation.
